title: Uruguayan Beef Empanadas à la Française
description: A French twist on the classic Uruguayan empanadas, filled with tender beef and onions.
instructions: 2. In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
3. Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
4. In a large bowl, combine the cooked beef and onion mixture, flour, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
5. Roll out the empanada pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
6. Use a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out circles of dough.
7. Place a tablespoon or two of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle.
8. Brush the edges of the dough with a little water, then fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
9. Press the edges together to seal the empanada, then use a fork to crimp the edges.
10. Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little egg wash.
11. Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
12. Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
